credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds dividends and buybacks combined, so shareholder returns are funded from internally generated cash rather than incremental borrowing, a meaningful support for the credit profile.

Interest coverage sits well above the sector median and far above unity, reflecting a large operating income base relative to gross interest expense and providing substantial cushion against earnings volatility.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage rose year over year and now sits above the sector median, with debt increasing while operating income declined, so the balance sheet has less headroom than the prior year despite an intermediate indicative risk profile.

The filing flags forward-looking risk disclosure covering operating performance and business risks, and operating margin fell year over year and trails the sector median, indicating earnings pressure that could erode debt-service cushion if sustained.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow covers dividends but falls short of total distributions, so buybacks rely on balance-sheet capacity; free cash flow to debt also trails the sector median, a modest weakness in deleveraging speed.

The current ratio is below one and below the sector median, though it improved year over year; liquidity depends on refinancing short-term maturities, and cash holdings provide only partial offset to the current liability base.

overall_credit_view.text: Net leverage remains below the next risk-band boundary with limited headroom, and cash flow to net debt sits just above its threshold, so the intermediate indicative profile is appropriate but sensitive to further EBITDA erosion.

The global beverage and convenient foods franchise generates resilient cash flow and strong interest coverage, supporting an investment-grade-like view; the key watch items are margin recovery, leverage direction and refinancing of current maturities.

credit_strengths.text: 經營現金流穩健地超過股息與回購的總和，因此股東回報由內部產生的現金而非新增借貸提供資金，對信貸狀況構成有意義的支持。
利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，且遠高於一，反映相對總利息支出而言營運收入基礎龐大，並為盈利波動提供充裕緩衝。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿按年上升，現已高於行業中位數，債務增加而營運收入下降，因此儘管屬中間指示性風險狀況，資產負債表的餘裕仍較上一年度為少。
申報文件標示涵蓋營運表現及業務風險的前瞻性風險披露，而營運利潤率按年下降並落後於行業中位數，顯示盈利壓力若持續，可能侵蝕償債緩衝。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流覆蓋股息但不足以覆蓋總分派，因此回購依賴資產負債表能力；自由現金流對債務比率亦落後於行業中位數，為去槓桿速度的一項溫和弱點。
流動比率低於一且低於行業中位數，儘管按年有所改善；流動性取決於短期到期債務的再融資，而現金持有僅能部分抵銷流動負債基礎。

overall_credit_view.text: 淨槓桿仍低於下一個風險區間邊界，但餘裕有限，而現金流對淨債務比率僅略高於其門檻，因此中間指示性狀況屬適當，但對EBITDA進一步侵蝕敏感。
全球飲料及方便食品特許經營業務產生具韌性的現金流及強勁的利息覆蓋率，支持類投資級觀點；主要關注事項為利潤率復甦、槓桿方向及短期到期債務的再融資。
